item.title: 🤝 Merger · Definitive · PUSA
item.scanner:headline: Acquires Powerus for 83.3% of combined entity; exchange ratio 599.18
item.description:
Acquires Powerus for 83.3% of combined entity; exchange ratio 599.18

Acquires Autonomous Power Corporation (Powerus) via merger of a subsidiary. Powerus stockholders receive 599.18229 AGH shares per Powerus share, plus up to 55 million earn-out shares, and will own ~83.3% of the combined company (Newco). The merger was approved by written consent of AGH's majority stockholder and Powerus stockholders; no stockholder vote is required. Closing is subject to HSR clearance, Nasdaq listing, and effectiveness of this S-4, with closing at least 20 days after mailing of the information statement.

About: Aureus Greenway Holdings Inc., through its subsidiaries, owns and operates public golf country clubs in the United States. The company engages in golf recreation; retail of golf products and equipment and facilities rental, including pro shops that offer golf balls, golf-gloves, logoed hats, and polos, as well as golf product and car rental; and membership dues services.

  • Counterparty: Autonomous Power Corporation (Powerus)
  • Consideration: stock
  • Announced: 2026-03-08
  • Next catalyst: S-4 effectiveness and 20-day waiting period after mailing

item.title: 🤝 Merger · Definitive · LXP
item.scanner:headline: Acquired by Brookfield/CPP for $61.20/share cash; close Q4 2026
item.description:
Acquired by Brookfield/CPP for $61.20/share cash; close Q4 2026

Entered into a definitive merger agreement to be acquired by affiliates of Brookfield Asset Management and Canada Pension Plan Investment Board for $61.20 per share in cash, valuing the transaction at approximately $5.2 billion including net debt and preferred equity. The all-cash offer represents a 12.3% premium to LXP's 30-day VWAP and a 19.8% premium to its 90-day VWAP. The merger was unanimously approved by LXP's board and is expected to close by the end of the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to shareholder approval and other customary conditions.

About: LXP Industrial Trust is a publicly traded real estate investment trust (REIT) focused on Class A warehouse and distribution investments in 12 target markets across the Sunbelt and lower Midwest. LXP seeks to expand its warehouse and distribution portfolio through acquisitions, build-to-suit transactions, sale-leaseback transactions, development projects and other transactions. LXP Industrial Trust was incorporated in 1993 and is based in West Palm Beach, United States.

  • Counterparty: Brookfield Asset Management / CPP Investments
  • Offer price: $61.20 per share
  • Deal value: $5.2 billion (including net debt and preferred equity)
  • Premium: 12.3% (30-day VWAP); 19.8% (90-day VWAP)
  • Consideration: cash
  • Announced: 2026-07-19
  • Expected Close: Q4 2026
  • Next catalyst: Shareholder vote

It operates in two segments, Retail Media and Performance Media. The Retail Media segment connects brands to shoppers at the digital point of sale through personalized ads that appear on retailer websites and across the open internet.

item.description:

FOXO Technologies, through subsidiary Vector BioSource, entered into an asset purchase agreement to acquire four U.S.-based blood collection centers from Grifols Bio Supplies for $3.5 million in cash at closing, with an earn-out of up to $1.0 million if the acquired business generates at least $1.5 million in EBITDA in any single year from 2026 to 2028. Closing is subject to customary conditions and new standalone regulatory approvals, including FDA licensure, CLIA certification in Tennessee and other operating states, and a Miami waste-management permit. The company expects closing in the third or fourth quarter of 2026.

About: FOXO Technologies Inc. operates as a healthcare services and technology company in the United States. It operates through three segments: Healthcare, Life Science Services, and Labs. item.scanner:headline: Amends PAGC merger; sponsor forfeits 50% founder shares, rights tender $0.25-$0.35, potential third target
item.description:
Amends PAGC merger; sponsor forfeits 50% founder shares, rights tender $0.25-$0.35, potential third target

DMAA (SPAC) entered into Amendment No. 3 to its merger agreement with Power Analytics Global Corp (PAGC). The amendment requires the sponsor to forfeit at least 50% of founder shares and subject the remainder to earnout vesting, and to commence a cash tender offer for outstanding rights at $0.25-$0.35 per right. The parties are also negotiating a potential three-party combination with an additional target, contingent on a definitive LOI by September 30, 2026. Minimum cash target is $30M with a $15M floor.

About: Drugs Made In America Acquisition Corp. does not have significant operations. It intends to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization, or other similar business combinations with one or more businesses. Drugs Made In America Acquisition Corp. was incorporated in 2024 and is based in New York, New York.

  • Counterparty: Power Analytics Global Corp
  • Announced: 2026-07-14
  • Next catalyst: Potential three-party LOI deadline Sep 30, 2026; proxy mailing pending

item.description:
Disclosure supplement for $3.15/share cash tender offer from ANV

Is supplementing its Schedule 14D-9 to address stockholder lawsuits alleging disclosure deficiencies in the original recommendation statement. The tender offer by ANV Group Holdings Ltd. to acquire all outstanding shares for $3.15 per share in cash remains pending. The company denies the allegations but voluntarily provides additional background details, including that no other parties submitted offers during the market check.

About: Open Lending Corporation provides lending enablement and risk analytics solutions to credit unions, regional banks, finance companies, and captive finance companies of automakers in the United States. The company offers lenders protection platform (LPP), which is a cloud-based automotive lending enablement platform that provides loan analytics solutions and automated issuance of credit default insurance with third-party insurance providers.
